title: Autonomous Neuro-Symbolic Verification of Operating System Kernels: A Resource-Aware Agentic Framework in Lean 4 and Rust (Wave 16 Verified Baseline)
description: Comprehensive formal verification artifact for the RunuX Minimum Viable Kernel (MVK) and AutoevolveAI ANSE engine. Includes 37 Lean 4 formal specification modules (12,164 LOC), 448 formal theorems and axioms, zero constant stubs across 316 Rust kernel crates, 609 unit tests, 23 cryptographic attestation receipts, and full publication manuscript in LaTeX and PDF.
